mostWorthwhile.text: Tracing the refusal from the dispatch fields through the published policy and capacity log was worthwhile: it connected an individual failed delivery to concrete commercial decisions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt to fit the matching rails was frustrating because the necessary mount adjustment was not apparent until the attempt failed.

surprise.text: The empty van was reserved for someone else, while the clinic's address and contracted revenue affected its eligibility and priority.

arbitrary.text: The rails initially having no available combination felt a little arbitrary, although repairing the mount afterward gave the sequence a practical explanation.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see whether the neighbors can use what they learned about the refusal to change access, especially since explaining the idle van did not give them its keys.
